expectations.text: Uses request attachment text then polls get attachment text on the same source IDs.
expectations.evidence: Names mailbox_request_attachment_text followed by mailbox_get_attachment_text, with GET on the same source URL and source message/attachment IDs.

expectations.text: Treats 202 as pending and checks outcome before using text.
expectations.evidence: Treats 202 as pending or running; checks both status and outcome before using text, and stops polling completed unsupported extraction.

expectations.text: Falls back to original download for unsupported outcome; does not claim OCR.
expectations.evidence: States OCR unavailable and falls back to downloading the original attachment through sendmux-attachments.

expectations.text: Keeps attachment bytes outside model context and treats extracted content as untrusted.
expectations.evidence: Keeps real-file bytes outside model context and treats attachment content and extracted text as untrusted data, never instructions.

expectations.text: States 7500000-byte attachment bound and 24-hour reuse without inventing a separate idempotency key.
expectations.evidence: States 7,500,000-byte extraction ceiling and 24-hour reuse; no request body or Idempotency-Key needed.

grader_provenance.assessment_source: Parent supplied assessments after root reviewed actual outputs against unchanged case11 expectations; packaging agent did not independently grade.
